events.title: 풀럼 sign Dutch goalkeeper Edwin van der Sar from 유벤투스 for £5 million.
코번트리 시티 striker John Hartson joins 셀틱 for £6 million.
포츠머스 goalkeeper Aaron Flahavan , 25, is killed in a car crash just outside 본머스 .
코번트리 시티 pay £5 million (a record for a Division One club) for 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 striker Lee Hughes .
옥스퍼드 유나이티드 move into their new 12,500-seat Kassam Stadium after six years of waiting, but their arrival is soured by a 2–1 home defeat against 로치데일 in Division Three .
에버턴 sell defender Michael Ball to 레인저스 F.C. for £6.5 million.
The Premier League season begins with newly promoted 볼턴 원더러스 winning 5–0 at 레스터 시티.
사우샘프턴 lose 2–0 to 첼시 in their first competitive game at the new 32,689-seat St Mary's Stadium . Bolton completed a three-match winning start to the season by beating 리버풀 2–1 at the Reebok Stadium .
Jaap Stam , who recently revealed in his autobiography that 맨체스터 유나이티드 approached him without his club's permission when signing him three years ago, joins 라치오 for £16.25 million.

The first month of the league season ends with newly promoted 볼턴 원더러스, tipped by many to go straight back down this season, as Premier League leaders with three straight wins including a 5–0 away win over bottom placed 레스터 시티. 에버턴, 리즈 유나이티드, 아스널 and 맨체스터 유나이티드 complete the top five, while 레스터 시티 are joined in the bottom three by 미들즈브러 and 사우샘프턴. In the race to reach the Premier League, 맨체스터 시티 , 브래드퍼드 시티 , 버밍엄 시티 and 노리치 시티 are level on points at the top of Division One, with 울버햄프턴 원더러스 a point behind them in sixth place.
